name: Debre Berhan University Student Portal
description: DBU student portal — login, academic summary, and registration extraction via DevExpress AJAX APIs.

login_steps.description: Click Log in button and wait for dashboard

post_login_steps.description: Select curriculum from DevExpress SelectBox dropdown (optional — API extraction handles this internally)

extraction_targets.name: curriculum_info
extraction_targets.description: Fetch curriculum list from DevExpress API

extraction_targets.name: student_basic_info
extraction_targets.description: Fetch student basic info for each curriculum

extraction_targets.name: academic_summary
extraction_targets.js_extract: (async () => { const unwrap = async (url) => { const r = await fetch(url); const j = await r.json(); return (j && j.data && Array.isArray(j.data)) ? j.data : j; }; const curricula = await unwrap('/RegistrationSummary/GetCurriculumInfo'); if (!curricula.length) return { error: 'no curricula found', curricula }; const curr = curricula[0]; const students = await unwrap('/RegistrationSummary/GetStudentBasicInfo?curriculumCode=' + curr.CurriculumTblCode); if (!students.length) return { error: 'no students found', curricula, students }; const stu = students[0]; const registrations = await unwrap('/RegistrationSummary/GetStudentRegistration?studentCurriculumCode=' + stu.StudentCurriculumTblCode); return { curriculum: curr, student: stu, registrations: registrations }; })()
extraction_targets.description: Chain-fetch: curriculum -> student info -> semester registrations with SGPA/CGPA

extraction_targets.name: page_content
extraction_targets.js_extract: (() => { return { url: window.location.href, title: document.title, body_text: document.body ? document.body.innerText.substring(0, 10000) : '' }; })()
